title: Public Economics
description: An application of economic analysis to the study of the role of government. Emphasis is on the reasons for and the effects of government intervention in the economy. Topics covered include: market failure, public goods and externalities, welfare policy, voting and public choice, taxation, public debt and cost-benefit analysis.
prerequisites: ECO 401 or 403 or equivalent. Agricultural Economics majors may substitute AEC 303 for this prerequisite
